result.summary: The page appears largely functional and well-structured, but there are a few layout and styling inconsistencies, particularly with cut-off text and elements.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text 'Restarants' is misspelled.
The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off, suggesting it should be 'Trattoria Piccolo'.
issues.suggestion: Increase the width of the card or reduce font size to ensure the full name is visible.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom of the screen is partially obscured/cut off by the navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom padding or margin of the content container to ensure the entire card is visible when scrolling.
